title: Table 2.1 Climb from brake release: time (min), fuel (kg), distance (nam)

notes: Enter with brake-release weight and the ISA deviation at 2/3 of the climb, to the nearest 5 °C.

Time and distance are used as printed; interpolated fractions are kept. Fuel is rounded to the nearest kg when interpolated.
